text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
I brought some refreshments today. They're 
sweets that are easy to digest and great 
for recovery from fatigue.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
"...Seeing everyone improve their 
performance day by day inspires me to step 
up my game too. Keep up the great work!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching <chrname>'s training seemed to give her 
some good inspiration.
